Маленька крамниця, де пахне землею й пів: A little shop that smells of soil and peonies. They make up bouquets, sell fruit tree saplings, and can arrange a bouquet from your own flowers.
Кав'ярня на розі, куди заходять по каву: The corner café where people drop in for coffee and the news. Mornings bring a queue with travel mugs, evenings long talks until closing. The cook will gladly take fresh fish.
Пекарня відчиняється ще затемна: о четве: The bakery opens while it is still dark: by four the palianytsias are going into the oven. Everything is gone by lunch, so don't be late. They'll take your flour too.
Звичайна сільська крамниця: молоко, мед,: An ordinary village shop: milk, honey, flour, seeds for the garden. You can bring in vegetables from your own plot here as well.
Тиха бібліотека з дерев'яними полицями й: A quiet library with wooden shelves and lamps over the tables. You can take a book home — just remember to bring it back.
Ратуша з годинником над входом. Тут прий: The town hall with a clock over the door. The head of the community sees people here, certificates are issued, and money is collected for the town's shared projects. Closed at weekends.
Господарчий, де є все: фарба, дошки, цвя: A hardware store that has everything: paint, boards, nails, ladders, fishing rods, buckets. The clerk will tell you what you need for the job.
Серце Липового: фонтан, лавки й місце дл: The heart of Lypove: a fountain, benches and room for fairs and festivals. Someone is always sitting here, even at night.
Ринок під навісами: овочі, фрукти, всяка: A market under awnings: vegetables, fruit and odds and ends from the villages around. Busiest in the morning.
Сільська школа з подвір'ям і старим клен: The village school with its yard and an old maple. On weekdays the bells ring; at weekends it is quiet. The music room has sheet music.
Лікарня працює вдень і вночі: вдень прий: The hospital works day and night: doctors see people by day, a nurse is on duty at night. The pharmacy is here too.
Відділок поліції, де завжди хтось на чер: The police station, where someone is always on duty. People come here when something has happened — by day or by night.
Пожежна частина з червоними воротами. Че: The fire station with its red gates. They are on duty around the clock — if something is burning, they're already on the way.
Пошта «Липове»: листи, посилки й полиця: The Lypove post office: letters, parcels and a shelf of electronics — phones and laptops are bought here. The postman sets out on the round at seven.
Комунальна контора: тут сплачують рахунк: The utilities office: pay the electricity and water bills here and ask when the pipe will be fixed. Weekdays only.
Майстерня «Друге життя» лагодить те, що: The “Second Life” workshop mends what others would throw away. The craftsman sells boards and nails and is always glad to look at something you've made.
Ветклініка «Лапка»: лікують, щеплять і г: The “Lapka” vet clinic: they treat, vaccinate and feed the stray cats by the door. Pet food is sold here too.
Спортзал «Сила» з грушею, штангами й тре: The “Syla” gym with a punching bag, barbells and a coach who won't let you slack. Open until late in the evening.
Бар «Жабка» оживає увечері: дартс, музич: The “Zhabka” bar comes alive in the evening: darts, a jukebox, lemonade and local wine. Open past midnight.
Дитячий майданчик із гойдалками, гіркою: A playground with swings, a slide and a sandpit. Always open, but noisiest after school.
Парк біля озера: доріжки, лавки й верби: The park by the lake: paths, benches and willows over the water. Lovely by day and at sunset.
Хлібзавод «Колос» пече хліб для всього к: The “Kolos” bread factory bakes bread for the whole area. You can mill your own flour here. Most of the work is done before lunch.
Стара водонапірна вежа. Внизу кран із пи: The old water tower. At the bottom there's a tap with drinking water, at the top a viewing platform overlooking all of Lypove. Climbing is on weekdays only.
Цегляний костел зі старим органом. Можна: A brick church with an old organ. You can light a candle or simply sit in the quiet. Open from morning to evening.
Підстанція за огорожею гуде собі тихеньк: The substation hums quietly behind its fence. From here the light goes to every home in Lypove.
Узлісся на краю села: стежки, гриби післ: The edge of the woods at the end of the village: paths, mushrooms after rain and shade in summer. The road to the forest starts here.
Хостел «Лелека» для тих, хто в дорозі. Н: The “Leleka” hostel for those on the road. You can nap for a few hours at the front desk. The desk is open from morning till late evening.
Редакція «Липового вісника». Тут пишуть: The newsroom of “The Lypove Herald”. They write about everything that happened that day and take ads for the next issue.
Крамниця одягу «Льон»: прості речі з нат: The “Lon” clothes shop: simple things in natural fabrics and scraps for those who sew their own. Closed on Sundays.
Перукарня «Локон»: стрижки, укладки й на: The “Lokon” hair salon: haircuts, styling and the freshest gossip. The hairdresser rests on Sundays and Mondays.
Пончикова: глазур, вишневий джем, шокола: The donut shop: glaze, cherry jam, chocolate and a coffee to go with your donut. Donuts are baked in the morning and sold until evening.
СТО «Гайка» лагодить машини всього район: The “Haika” garage repairs cars from all over the district. There's petrol in cans and a coffee machine for those who wait.
Автошкола «Зелене світло»: теорія в клас: The “Green Light” driving school: theory in the classroom, practice on the streets of Lypove with an instructor. The instructor is in every day except Sunday.
Храм Тихого Лотоса — місце для тиші й ме: The Temple of the Quiet Lotus — a place for silence and meditation. A gong, incense, prayer wheels. It opens at dawn.
Радіо «Липове FM» в ефірі з ранку до веч: “Lypove FM” is on air from morning to evening. You can request a song here and buy a record.
Кінотеатр «Зоря» з плюшевими кріслами й: The “Zoria” cinema with plush seats and popcorn. Showings from early afternoon until night; a different film at weekends.
Пилорама в лісі: тут розпилюють колоди н: The sawmill in the forest: logs are sawn into boards and beams here. Loud, and it smells of resin. Quiet on Sundays.
Сонячна галявина в лісі, де лісник стежи: A sunny glade in the forest where the forester keeps things in order. A good place for a rest.
Вирубка: пні, штабелі колод і стежка, як: The logging site: stumps, stacks of logs and the track they're hauled out along.
Старе коло каменів у лісовій гущавині. Н: An old circle of stones deep in the woods. No one remembers who put them there.
Звалище за селом. Збирач працює зранку,: The dump outside the village. The collector works in the mornings, and at weekends there's a flea market — treasures turn up among the junk.
Пшеничні поля аж до обрію. Влітку тут жн: Wheat fields as far as the horizon. Harvest in summer; stubble and birds in autumn.
Ферма «Липовий гай»: корови, вівці, кури: The “Linden Grove” farm: cows, sheep, hens and a farmer who gets up before the sun.
Міні-фабрика «Овечка»: тут прядуть вовну: The “Ovechka” mini-mill: wool is spun, scarves are woven and cheese is made here. You can do some of the work yourself.
Іподром «Буревій»: стайні, бігова доріжк: The “Burevii” racecourse: stables, a track and stands. The grooms are here from six in the morning, and all of Lypove gathers for the races.
Печера за пагорбом. Старий шахтар знає т: A cave behind the hill. The old miner knows every turn in it — don't go far without him.
Виноробня «Лоза» серед виноградників. Ту: The “Loza” winery among the vineyards. They sell wine from their own vines and keep the barrels in a cool cellar.
Тихе кладовище під липами. Доглядач підм: A quiet cemetery under the lindens. The caretaker sweeps the paths every day except Sunday.
